disposition: Inert recovery source snapshots. Filenames indicate possible authored inputs but do not establish authorship or execution readiness.
limits: This scan excludes generated/runtime outputs, dependency/cache trees, explicit nested Git copies, and paths whose role as copied source versus authoring was unclear. It does not establish that files outside this scope are preserved.
scope: Held root untracked-source candidate list and a supplemental list of explicit recipe, schema, design, plan, policy and fixture JSON filenames. Review uses observed path roles and exact content identity.
scope_boundary: This bounded selection includes root-held authored-looking source, drivers, configurations, and documentation after excluding identifiable copies. File origin and authorship can be uncertain in mixed experiment directories. No retained file establishes integration, current-source binding, or execution readiness.
